spans.s:
Adma-sad.--This expression (lit. ‘sitting at the meal’), found several times in the Rigveda, is usually rendered ‘guest at the feast,’ but Geldner adduces reasons to show that it means ‘a fly,’ so called because of its settling on food.
Foot notes i. 124, 4; vi. 30, 3; vii. 83, 7; viii. 44, 29; adma-sadvan, vi. 4, 4.
Vedische Studien, 2, 179, 180; but of Oldenberg, Vedaforschung, 90.
